The text discusses issues concerning almsgiving and offerings yielding great fruit, a topic intimately tied in canonical literature to the two meals said to bear the greatest fruit in the Buddha's life—the meal prior to awakening and the final meal before his parinibbāna [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
